title: Kraft's plugin on Cursor and Antigravity; release stamp covers every manifest
body:
## What

## Changelog

- Kraft's plugin now installs on Cursor (`agent plugin marketplace add https://github.com/itsOmidKarami/kraft`, then `/plugins`) and on Antigravity (`agy plugin import` from a clone), with its skills and the `kraft` MCP server. Amp can add the skills with `amp skill add`.

Existing Claude Code and Codex installs are unchanged, apart from the MCP server now coming from `plugins/kraft/.mcp.json` (same command, same `plugin:kraft:kraft` name). The Cursor manifests' `version` is stamped with the others from the next release.

title: Antigravity CLI (agy) harness

## What

## Changelog

- New `antigravity` harness runs agent tasks on Google's Antigravity CLI (`agy`), the replacement for Gemini CLI on individual Google accounts. It reads tokens, the conversation id for resume, and quota stops from its stream-json log. `prices.json` now includes Google's Gemini models, so a session launched with a base model id and `effort` gets a dollar estimate.

title: Review submit takes a chain revision's digest
body:
`ReviewIn` carried no digest, so `_submit` approved with `approve_gate(..., None)` and every chain_revision gate answered 409. It now takes an optional `digest`, passed to the gate approval exactly as `POST /gates/{gate}/approve` takes it. A non-revision gate ignores it; a revision gate without one keeps its 409 and message.

## Changelog

Approving a chain-revision gate from a review now works: the review submit takes the revision's digest.

## Release impact

`release::patch`

title: UX V2 W13 A: draft rebase and fragment routes
body:

title: DELETE /repos refuses with 409 while a live item uses the repo
body:
## What
`DELETE /api/repos?path=` now answers 409 naming the count when a work item that has not ended (active, paused, needs_human) uses the repo. Before, it returned 204 and stranded the item: its worktree and merge steps could no longer resolve the repo. It reuses `open_counts_by_repo`, the count the repos draft's `remove_repo` already reports as a problem, so the two paths agree.

## Changelog
Fix: disconnecting a repository that still has running work items is refused with a 409 instead of stranding them.

## Release impact
`release::patch`

title: UX V2 W18 (PR 2): the cutover: the new UI at /, the shipped UI deleted, theme.yaml migrated
body:
UX V2 wave W18, PR 2 of 2: the cutover. The new web UI moves from `/ng` to `/`, the shipped UI and its tests go, and `theme.yaml` is migrated once at startup. PR 1 (#388) laid the groundwork: the migration function, the shipped-address aliases and the new e2e specs.

## Changelog

**Kraft 1.5.0: a new web interface.**

Kraft's web UI is redesigned, at the same address. The board groups what needs you, what is running, what hasn't started and what is done, with a docked peek and bulk actions. The item page draws the chain, and each node, step and task opens in a side pane with its log, documents and config. A review page holds diffs, threads and gate decisions. Templates (Chains, Library, Harnesses, Repos) and Policy edit a draft that you review and publish. Phones get their own layout. The old interface is removed.

- **What moved.** Settings → Chains, Library, Harnesses and Repos are now under **Templates**. An item's Changes tab is its **Review** page. Documents open from the task that wrote them. The Timeline is the task log and the board's event list. Old addresses still work: `/settings/chains`, `/settings/notify`, `#node=` links and `/ng/...` bookmarks all redirect. Links from the CLI, notifications and the VS Code extension are unchanged.
- **Your theme.** On its first start, 1.5.0 rewrites `theme.yaml`. Your `palette` becomes `surface`, `accent` and `colour_amount`, and `palette` is removed. Your colours, mode and density stay as they were, and the old file is kept as `theme.yaml.pre-ux2`. A `palette` key is still read in 1.5; the next release refuses it.
- **Cancel keeps the branch.** Cancel stops an item and keeps its branch and worktree. To delete them too, use `kraft item abandon`.

## Removed tests

- frontend/e2e/v2/attachments.visual.spec.ts -- moved to frontend/e2e/attachments.visual.spec.ts (J)

title: Raise cap on a policy budget_usd stop: dollars, PATCH the policy, retry (desktop and phone)
body:
## What / Evidence

## Changelog

Fixed: Raise cap on a budget stop that a policy `budget_usd` caused (desktop and the phone's Raise budget) now raises that policy in dollars and retries, instead of failing with a 409. A budget stop on the item's own cap still raises with Raise budget.

## Removed tests

- `frontend/src/ng/phone/item/Item.test.tsx::raising the cap that stopped the item (R73) > a stop.limit on a stop that is not a cap draws nothing` is replaced by `... a stop.limit on a stop that is neither a cap nor a budget draws nothing`, with the budget case now drawing the dollar sheet (see `raising a policy budget_usd that stopped the item`).

## Release impact

`release::patch`: a shipped behaviour fix, and `stop.limit` gains `key: budget_usd` on the detail (additive; documented in `7.http-api.md`).
